# KASHFARA VISION — Full Product & Technical Overview

URL: https://kashfara.com
Interactive Live Demo: https://kashfara.com/demo

## Executive Summary
KASHFARA VISION is an enterprise multimodal document intelligence platform powered by a compact 4-billion-parameter (4B) OCR + Vision model purpose-trained for Arabic and English documents. Designed for Middle East and global businesses, it automates document classification, key-value extraction, table extraction, form digitalisation, and grounded document Q&A while keeping compute overhead low and accuracy high.

## Why Businesses Choose Kashfara Vision
1. **Built for Arabic RTL + English Bilingual Layouts**: Preserves right-to-left Arabic script, mixed Arabic-English tables, numbers, dates, stamps, and handwritten signatures without dropping or mangling text.
2. **Low-Compute Hybrid Architecture**: Digital PDFs and Office files (DOCX, PPTX, XLSX) are structurally parsed first; page renders and text layers are combined for fast multimodal reasoning.
3. **Verifiable Proof of Evidence**: Unlike black-box extractors, Kashfara anchors every field to its source page, verbatim quote, and normalized `[0..1]` bounding box, distinguishing model-proposed, source-matched, and visually verified fields.
4. **Instant Form Digitalisation**: Converts paper or scanned forms into editable digital forms with empty-field preservation, Arabic RTL support, JSON/CSV export, and print formatting.
5. **Stateless Privacy**: Documents in the live demo are processed without persistent server file storage.

## Supported Document Formats
- PDF (multi-page, scanned or digital)
- Images: PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, TIFF
- Office Documents: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX

## Industry Use Cases
- **Finance, VAT & Tax Compliance**: Automated processing of FTA/ZATCA tax invoices, credit notes, bank statements, and vendor bills.
- **Banking & FinTech**: Corporate KYC, financial statement parsing, and trade finance workflows.
- **Real Estate & Property Management**: Commercial and residential lease extraction, inspection reports, and handover forms.
- **Logistics & Supply Chain**: Bills of Lading, packing lists, delivery notes, and ERP-ready JSON/CSV export.
- **Legal & HR**: Bilingual contracts, employment offers, and employee onboarding forms.
- **Healthcare & Insurance**: Claims adjudication, policy schedules, and diagnostic/lab reports.
